notablePrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.
